pairs: Thus says the Lord to me:
and obtain for yourself a linen waistcloth.
et pones illud super lumbos tuos,
And you shall place it over your loins,
et in aquam non inferes illud.
and you shall not put it into water.”
Et possedi lumbare juxta verbum Domini,
And so I obtained a waistcloth, according to the word of the Lord,
and I placed it around my loins.
Et factus est sermo Domini ad me secundo,
And the word of the Lord came to me a second time,
which is around your loins, and,
rising up, go to the Euphrates,
et absconde ibi illud in foramine petræ.
and hide it there in an opening of the rock.”
and I hid it by the Euphrates,
just as the Lord had instructed me.
Et factum est post dies plurimos,
And it happened that, after many days,
the Lord said to me: “Rise up,
et tolle inde lumbare quod præcepi tibi ut absconderes illud ibi.
and take from there the waistcloth, which I instructed you to hide there.”
And so I went to the Euphrates,
and I dug up and took the waistcloth from the place where I had hidden it.
et tuli lumbare de loco ubi absconderam illud:
ita ut nulli usui aptum esset.
so that it was not fit for any use.
Et factum est verbum Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
I will cause the arrogance of Judah and the arrogance of Jerusalem to rot.
populum istum pessimum qui nolunt audire verba mea,
This most wicked people, they are not willing to listen to my words,
et ambulant in pravitate cordis sui,
for they walk in the depravity of their own heart,
abieruntque post deos alienos ut servirent eis et adorarent eos:
and they have gone after strange gods, so as to serve them and to adore them. And so,
they will become like this waistcloth,
which is not fit for any use.
Sicut enim adhæret lumbare ad lumbos viri,
For just as the waistcloth clings to the loins of a man,
sic agglutinavi mihi omnem domum Israël,
so have I brought close to me the entire house of Israel and the entire house of Judah,
so that they would be to me:
Dices ergo ad eos sermonem istum:
Therefore, you shall speak to them this word:
Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel:
‘Every bottle will be filled with wine.’
And they will say to you:
Numquid ignoramus quia omnis laguncula implebitur vino?
‘Are we ignorant that every bottle will be filled with wine?’
And you shall say to them:
Ecce ego implebo omnes habitatores terræ hujus,
Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land,
et reges qui sedent de stirpe David super thronum ejus,
and the kings from the stock of David who sit upon his throne,
and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem,
Et dispergam eos virum a fratre suo,
and I will not pardon them,
and I will not take pity,
so as not to destroy them.”
Do not choose to lift yourself up,
Date Domino Deo vestro gloriam antequam contenebrescat,
Give glory to the Lord your God,
et antequam offendant pedes vestri ad montes caliginosos:
and before your feet stumble on the darkened mountains.
et ponet eam in umbram mortis,
but he will turn it into the shadow of death and into utter darkness.
But if you will not listen to this,
in abscondito plorabit anima mea a facie superbiæ:
then my soul will weep in secret before the face of your pride.
and my eyes will flow with tears,
because the flock of the Lord has been taken captive.
“Say to the king and to the female ruler:
quoniam descendit de capite vestro corona gloriæ vestræ.
For the crown of your glory has gone down from your head.
The cities of the south have been closed,
and there is no one who may open them.
translata est omnis Juda transmigratione perfecta.
All of Judah has been taken away into complete captivity.
Lift up your eyes and see,
you who are arriving from the north.
ubi est grex qui datus est tibi,
Where is the flock that was given to you,
What will you say when he visits upon you?
tu enim docuisti eos adversum te,
For you have taught them against you,
and you have instructed them with your own head.
Will not pains take hold of you,
as with a woman in labor?
Quod si dixeris in corde tuo:
But if you say in your heart,
‘Why have these things happened to me?’
propter multitudinem iniquitatis tuæ revelata sunt verecundiora tua,
it is because of the greatness of your iniquity that your shame has been uncovered
and the soles of your feet have been defiled.
Si mutare potest Æthiops pellem suam,
If the Ethiopian is able to change his skin,
or the leopard is able to change his spots,
then you also may be able to do well,
Et disseminabo eos quasi stipulam quæ vento raptatur in deserto.
And I will scatter them like chaff, which is carried away by the wind in the desert.
and this is the portion of your measure from me,
and you have had confidence in what is false.
et ego nudavi femora tua contra faciem tuam,
I have even bared your thighs before your face,
and your shame has been seen.
For I have seen your adulteries,
et hinnitus tuus, scelus fornicationis tuæ:
and your neighing for the wickedness of your fornication,
super colles in agro vidi abominationes tuas.
and your abominations upon the hills in the field.
non mundaberis post me: usquequo adhuc?
How much longer before you will be made clean after me?”
